fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: The fund generally invests at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index (i.e., depositary receipts representing securities of the underlying index) and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents.

news.paragraph: Recent analysis of the iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM) has focused on pivot points and potential market movements, with some articles questioning its recent run-up and comparing its performance unfavorably to similar ETFs like VTWO. While one article highlighted the potential for certain small-cap stocks within the index to continue their upward trajectory, the overall sentiment suggests a period of technical observation rather than a clear directional signal for IWM itself.
